slides.title: Day 1. You're the only one at the warehouse who knows when anything expires.

slides.label: Day 3
slides.title: A new temp asks to drive the forklift.
slides.body: You find the certification binder. The newest card in it is from 2023.

slides.label: Day 6
slides.title: A customer wants your COI before they release the next order.
slides.body: You find three. None of them say 2026.

slides.label: Day 9
slides.title: The insurance renewal email went to someone who left in March.
slides.body: Their inbox still exists. Nobody has the password.

slides.label: Day 12
slides.title: The fire inspection tag on the sprinkler riser says "next due" and a month that already happened.
slides.body: You take a photo. You don't tell anyone yet.

slides.label: Day 14
slides.title: A car you don't recognize pulls into the lot.
slides.body: The driver is holding a clipboard.

slides.label: Day 15
slides.body: What happens next? Wrong answers only.
